messages:
maya: Quick sync — model intake for ‘ghoul-7B-open’ status. Timeline: want catalog entry + perf profile live by EOD Friday. Any blockers?

dan: I can finish the perf runs today, but need the license confirmation before we publish the model card.

sanjay: FYI, runtime tests found a KV cache bug with 7B shard layout, causing ~15% extra tail latency on long ctx. Working on a fix, PR incoming.

maya: Thanks. @sanjay can you guesstimate ETA for the fix? If it’s >48h we should document as known issue in the profile.

sanjay: ~6–8h to stabilize, then CI + perf sweep ~3h. So likely done today.

rachel: Legal looked at the weights license — it’s MIT-ish but requires the original model creators named in attribution. Legal asked for the source URL to include in the catalog entry.

maya: @rachel sending source URL now: https://models.example/ghoul-7b-v1.1

rachel: OK need that in the PR description and a one-line license note: "Weights licensed under MIT (see source) — attribution required." After that legal is 👍.

kevin: Quick runtime note: for cost estimates I need the token/sec from the perf runs on A100-80GB and T4. Dan can you paste numbers in this thread?

dan: On A100-80GB, FP16 baseline: 420 tok/s steady for seq_len=1024. INT8 quantized (llm-int8): ~680 tok/s. T4 numbers: FP16 ~120 tok/s, INT8 ~200 tok/s. These are single-request numbers w/ batching disabled.

kevin: Perfect, thanks. I'll update the pricing calc.

olivia: Are we publishing a canary config for Dedicated? If so I need model tag to pin + rollout policy.

maya: Canary tag will be `ghoul-7b-open:v1-rc1`. Rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% in 2 hours -> 100% if no errors. Oliva can you set the route?

olivia: Setting now, will create the rollout config and add the metric alerts (latency p95 and error rate).

rachel: One legal ask: remove any training data examples in the model card that include proprietary snippets from third parties. We have to sanitize examples before publishing.

maya: Noted — @dan can you scrub the sample prompts/examples in the model card?

dan: Yep. I’ll replace proprietary examples with synthetic ones and push update.

sanjay: PR 4821 opened for the KV-cache fix + test. cc @maya @dan for review — self-review done, need one more from eng-runtime.

maya: Reviewing now. If I can merge today we can run a final perf sweep tied to the catalog entry.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — staging runtime test triggered for `ghoul-7b-open` on canary slot. Job #9982.

kevin: One more dependency for the public catalog page: product wants a short "safety/usage guidance" blurb. Can someone draft 2–3 lines?

maya: Draft: "Best for general-purpose text generation. May exhibit hallucinations on niche factual queries; validate outputs for high-stakes flows. Avoid using for regulated healthcare/legal decisions without human review." Keep?

kevin: Helpful, I’ll shorten for the UI.

olivia: Rollout config ready, alerts set, canary tag pinned. Will monitor.

rachel: Legal: once PR has the license line + source link and you remove proprietary examples, we can sign off.

maya: Action items recap: dan — scrub examples + paste perf numbers in PR desc; sanjay — merge KV fix and notify; olivia — create rollout (done); rachel — final legal sign-off once PR updated; kevin — update pricing calc and product copy. Aim: catalog publish by EOD Fri.

dan: On it. PR will have updated model card + perf snapshot.

sanjay: Merged KV fix, CI green. Perf sweep starting now.

maya: Awesome — thanks team. If anything slips ping this thread. :thumbsup:
